Hi all —

Quick band note and recommendation after checking compensation banding and budget:
- SDE2 band (SF / remote-US midpoint): Base midpoint $150k, range $135k–$175k.
- Typical target bonus: 10–12%
- Typical equity for SDE2: 0.03%–0.08% (4-year schedule) depending on seniority/impact.

Budget note for Markus: we have one open headcount in infra with $165k planned base budget. Moving base to $165k will consume the full base buffer for the hire but remains within annual hiring commit. We can accommodate $165k base if you approve, but we will need you to commit to the headcount now so we don’t reallocate to upcoming backlog roles.

Recommendation (final offer to candidate):
- Base: $165,000
- Annual target bonus: 12%
- Equity: 0.06% RSUs, 4-year vesting (25/25/25/25)
- Signing bonus: $7,500 discretionary (one-time) to help with relocation and ramp costs
- Start date: Aug 17, 2026 (flexible)

This keeps total cash reasonable ($165k + 12% + 7.5k sign) while offering a competitive equity piece. If you prefer a different mix (higher RSUs, lower base) I can model the alternate quickly.

Attachments:
- SDE2_offer_template_MK.docx (docx, 48 KB) — offer template with numbers filled in (draft).

Please reply with signoff so Samir can issue verbal and prepare formal docs.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
